x-uzfintech-source.note: hand-written from the docs.atmos.uz English page; trimmed to the documented fields; params = request body, result = whole answer body

endpoint: POST <your billing URL, agreed with Atmos>

invoice.description: your account / invoice number sent as account in pay/create

sign.description: hash of store_id + transaction_id + invoice + amount + api_key, no separators; the docs do not name the hash - run scripts/sign.py atmos.callback

x-note: Atmos calls you before it confirms the debit; answer HTTP 200. Money is taken only after status 1. Accept calls only from the Atmos address range on the vendor page.
